episode.tagline: We are surrounded by stories that need to be told, must be told, will blow your mind!
episode.about: In this episode, Amit and Ajay continue the series of talking about stories that should be films. Amit builds fiction based on IIT aspirants and vloggers, as well as a real life story about  the Delhi of the 1800s, a Delhi in churn. Ajay tells us about missing plutonium up on Nanda Devi, how a navy was once 'delivered' and a most unusual package parachuting down in Africa.
